requirements.source_text: Provide an isolated dev environment with no production data, credentials, or payment side effects.
Develop deploys to dev; task PRs target develop; release PRs promote develop to main.
An explicitly picked-up prompt/spec task creates a separate branch/worktree and resolves its Linear identity.
Branches use fix/, feat/, or docs/.
Commit messages and PR titles use fix:, feat:, or docs: and reference the Linear issue; PR descriptions link it directly.
Finished tasks with passing local and remote checks create or update a PR for owner review.
Protect main after dev and CI are ready; retain owner merge decision and a future automatic-review integration point.
Issues have barz-fe/barz-be/payments/platform area labels and bug/minor work uses the current cycle when available.
Preserve user changes, recover safely after partial failures, and avoid duplicate task artifacts.
Deliver a reviewable spec for implementation in a separate agent chat; do not enable the infrastructure in this documentation task.
